In typography , italic type (or italics , plurale tantum ) is a cursive font based on a stylised form of calligraphic handwriting . [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Along with blackletter and roman type , it served as one of the major typefaces in the history of Western typography . Owing to the influence from calligraphy , italics normally slant slightly to the right, like so . Different glyph shapes from roman type are usually used – another influence from calligraphy – and upper-case letters may have swashes , flourishes inspired by ornate calligraphy.
